participation.context: Wrote the hurry, struck the explanation, and stopped before the night.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

relations.note: fewer words, trusted to the boy

story.body: You let the father set the day. You took the long defence away from the girl. You left the fearful night, the dawn, and the tomb unwritten. The page is a decision, not a scene finished.

relations.note: fewer words, trusted to the boy

title: Struck eleven lines and kept her one turn

participation.context: Wrote the limit of the page, and kept to it.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You gave the hurry a date and the girl a shorter answer. You left the rest of the night for a later morning. Nothing was handed out at the Theatre, where you were not.

title: Kept the father on Thursday and the girl on fewer words
